set (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)

# Create a CMake target for generating a *.idl.cpp.h header file
# for a defined IDL file using the nkppmeta compiler.
add_nk_edl (jwt_example_web_server "${NK_RESOURCES}/jwt_example/WebServer.edl"
            NK_MODULE "jwt_example"
            LANG      "CXX")

# Bind CMake targets generated by the add_nk_idl(), add_nk_cdl(), and add_nk_edl() commands
# to the main CMake target for building the application.
bind_nk_targets (jwt_example_web_server jwt_example_token_service_idl)

add_executable (WebServer
                src/httpurihandler.cpp
                src/webserver.cpp
                src/allrequesthandler.cpp
                src/gettokenhandler.cpp
                src/getdatahandler.cpp
                src/log.cpp
                src/main.cpp)

bind_nk_targets (WebServer jwt_example_web_server)
target_include_directories (WebServer PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_definitions (WebServer PRIVATE AppTag="WebServer")

add_dependencies (WebServer openssl_headers)
target_link_libraries (WebServer PRIVATE
                       logrr_cpp::logrr_cpp-static
                       vfs::client
                       Threads::Threads
                       Boost::program_options
                       OpenSSL::SSL)

# Disable the default VFS entity that is automatically provided by vfs::client.
set_target_properties (WebServer PROPERTIES vfs_entity::entity_REPLACEMENT "")
